createTable.remarks: Shared text+moderation+edit-tracking atom reused by both a top-level feedback entry (via feedback.content_id) and its single reply (via feedback_comment.content_id) -- factored out since the shape is identical for both.

column.name: content_text
column.remarks: Sanitized HTML (OWASP HTML Sanitizer).

column.name: moderation_status
column.remarks: FeedbackModerationStatus -- NEW is visible by default, HIDDEN is pending/rejected admin moderation

column.name: moderation_reason
column.remarks: Moderator-facing reason text captured from the report popup when a user flags a feedback entry or its reply; null until the first report.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp, also the start of the 48h edit/delete window shared by feedback and its reply

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last edit, if any

column.name: version
column.remarks: Optimistic-lock counter (@Version, native CrudRepository.save())

createTable.remarks: A registered user's link row attaching one feedback_content+feedback_rating pair to an owning entity (PROVIDER_PROFILE or ADVERTISEMENT). No DB-level FK to provider_profile/advertisement, same entity_type+entity_id convention audit_log/contact_info already use -- resolved only via FeedbackPort, never a SQL join. At most one row per (author_id, entity_type, entity_id). Immutable after creation -- edits touch feedback_content/feedback_rating instead.

column.name: author_id
column.remarks: Author of the entry. References user_information(id), no FK

column.name: entity_type
column.remarks: Owning entity type (EntityType: PROVIDER_PROFILE or ADVERTISEMENT). No FK -- resolved via FeedbackPort, not a join

column.name: entity_id
column.remarks: ID of the owning entity. References provider_profile(id) or advertisement(id) depending on entity_type, no FK

column.name: content_id
column.remarks: FK to feedback_content -- this entry's text+moderation+edit-tracking state

createTable.remarks: 1:1 star rating for one feedback entry, split out of feedback so the rating and the text/moderation concerns can evolve/be edited independently.

column.name: feedback_id
column.remarks: FK to feedback, unique -- exactly one rating per feedback entry

column.name: rating
column.remarks: 1-5 star rating

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last edit, if any

createTable.remarks: The single reply to a feedback entry, written only by the owner of the reviewed PROVIDER_PROFILE being rated -- at most one per feedback entry, enforced by the unique constraint on feedback_id below.

column.name: content_id
column.remarks: FK to feedback_content -- this reply's text+moderation+edit-tracking state

column.name: author_id
column.remarks: Author of the reply. References user_information(id), no FK -- same convention as feedback.author_id

column.name: feedback_id
column.remarks: Which feedback entry this is the single reply to -- unique, so the database itself enforces at most one reply per feedback entry

createTable.remarks: Denormalized avg_rating/review_count for one owning entity, recomputed transactionally on every feedback write -- lives entirely inside this starter, same self-contained shape as contact_info, never a column on provider_profile/advertisement.

column.name: entity_type
column.remarks: Owning entity type (EntityType: PROVIDER_PROFILE or ADVERTISEMENT). No FK -- resolved via FeedbackPort, not a join

column.name: entity_id
column.remarks: ID of the owning entity. References provider_profile(id) or advertisement(id) depending on entity_type, no FK

column.name: avg_rating
column.remarks: Mean of feedback_rating.rating across all entries for this entity

column.name: review_count
column.remarks: Count of feedback entries for this entity

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last recompute timestamp
